sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report pertains to customer C13487 and debit/credit card C13487-K1. Graph analytics identified a shared hardware syndicate linking this account to multiple other customer profiles including C03744, C09354, C12033. Between 2016-11-21 and 2016-11-22, transaction activity totaling $74.96 USD was flagged for anomalous risk indicators, initiated via the online channel under merchant product category C. The primary flagged transaction 3478561 occurred on 2016-11-22 16:11:00 for an amount of $74.96. Online authentication originated from digital hardware profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' with proxy routing classified as 'IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS'. The modus operandi involved credential capture and card-not-present exploitation originating from an unrecognized new device profile without prior account history. Suspicion is corroborated by graph ring discovery confirming the hardware device was simultaneously utilized across 52 unrelated customer accounts within a compressed timeframe. The financial institution has permanently blocked card C13487-K1 to prevent further financial exposure, staged appropriate fraud chargebacks, and placed all connected cards under heightened surveillance.
